en.headline: Cebu Pacific flight returns to Hong Kong after suspected cargo door issue
en.dek: A Manila-bound Cebu Pacific Airbus A321 returned safely to Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday afternoon after its cargo door was suspected to have opened; no injuries were reported.
body: Police said officers were notified at about 3.05pm of an incident involving flight CEB143, a Cebu Pacific service bound for Manila. The aircraft, an Airbus A321, returned to Hong Kong International Airport and landed safely with no one injured, according to the force.

Flight-tracking data showed the flight had been scheduled to depart Hong Kong at 2pm and arrive in Manila at 4.25pm. It returned to the airport before departing again at 5.24pm and later arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport at 7.57pm.
Authorities did not provide further details on the cause or the extent of any inspection carried out before the aircraft was cleared to continue its journey.

zh.headline: 宿霧太平洋航班疑貨艙門開啟 折返香港機場安全着陸
zh.dek: 一班由香港飛往馬尼拉的宿霧太平洋航空CEB143航班周六下午疑因貨艙門開啟問題折返香港國際機場，安全着陸無人受傷。
body: 警方表示，下午約3時05分接報有關CEB143航班的事故。該架空中巴士A321客機折返香港國際機場並安全着陸，無人受傷。
航班追蹤資料顯示，該航班原定下午2時由香港起飛，預計下午4時25分抵達馬尼拉。客機折返後於下午5時24分再起飛，其後於晚上7時57分抵達尼諾伊·阿基諾國際機場。
當局未有進一步交代事件起因，或客機獲准繼續航程前進行的檢查詳情。
